asked.item: Why the page picker says "No LinkedIn pages found for this account"
Whether the company Page should show up with the Analyst role
How to get the company Page connected

verdict.reason: The help pages say the Analyst role does not expose a Page to Blotato, and they give the role requirement and the steps to connect the Page.

steps.text: The "No LinkedIn pages found for this account" message is informational, not an error, and your personal LinkedIn profile is already connected.
The Page isn't listed because Analyst access does not expose the Page to Blotato.
Your profile must have the Super Admin or Content Admin role on the Page.
Ask a Super Admin to update your role, then reconnect from an incognito Chrome window and select the Page.
If your role stays unchanged, ask a Super Admin or Content Admin to connect the Page to Blotato.
